basics.name: Luca Piccinini
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer
basics.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years of experience building fintech and cryptocurrency products. Specialized in Python (Django, FastAPI) and TypeScript (NestJS), designing scalable systems, microservices and event-driven architectures. Experienced in distributed systems, cloud-native applications, AWS, RabbitMQ, Redis, PostgreSQL and MongoDB. Strong background in backend engineering, technical design and cross-functional collaboration, with additional experience building web and mobile applications using React and React Native. I actively leverage modern AI-powered development tools, including Claude Code and OpenAI Codex, to accelerate software delivery, improve code quality and enhance engineering productivity.
